sloka: दृष्ट्वा त्वामभिषेकार्द्रं कौसल्यामभिवाद्य च ।अचिरेणागमिष्यामः स्वान् गृहान् नृपतेः सुत ।। ६.१२५.२२ ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tvāmabhiṣekārdraṁ kausalyāmabhivādya ca ।acireṇāgamiṣyāmaḥ svān gṛhān nṛpateḥ suta ।। 6.125.22 ।।

translations.english: "If I with my dear and near and together with you go to Ayodhya, that will give more happiness with Sita coming and with all of you."
